qs.s: Le stationnement est ___ dans cette rue, sous peine d'amende.
qs.en: Parking is prohibited in this street, under penalty of a fine.

qs.s: Ce pesticide est ___ à la vente depuis plusieurs années.
qs.en: This pesticide has been banned from sale for several years.

qs.en: Running in the school corridors is not allowed.

qs.s: L'usage du téléphone portable est ___ pendant l'examen.
qs.en: The use of mobile phones is not allowed during the exam.

qs.s: Les produits chimiques dangereux sont ___ dans les avions.
qs.en: Dangerous chemical products are prohibited on planes.

qs.en: Fireworks are banned in this residential neighbourhood.

qs.en: The sale of alcohol to minors is prohibited by law.

qs.en: Vehicle traffic is banned in this pedestrian zone.

qs.en: There was a thick fog on the road this evening.

qs.en: Syrian culture is rich in ancestral traditions.

qs.en: These Syrian craftsmen make beautiful rugs.

qs.s: Cette poétesse ___ écrit en arabe et en français.
qs.en: This Syrian poetess writes in Arabic and French.

qs.s: Ces familles ___ vivent depuis dix ans en Allemagne.
qs.en: These Syrian families have been living in Germany for ten years.

qs.s: Les femmes ___ ont manifesté pour leurs droits.
qs.en: Syrian women demonstrated for their rights.
